title: Ringed Cosmic Planet
description: A vibrant surreal planet with swirling blue, yellow, and orange surface patterns floats in space, encircled by glowing pink and purple rings dotted with small spheres. The background consists of expressive, painterly nebulae in magenta, orange, and dark crimson with bright yellow starbursts scattered throughout.
prompt: Surreal painted planet with swirling blue, turquoise, and golden yellow surface patterns, encircled by luminous pink and purple rings made of glowing dots, set against a vibrant cosmic background of expressive magenta, orange, and crimson nebulae with bright yellow starbursts, painterly brushstrokes and drips visible, dreamy celestial scene
